g.text: Nothing legitimate takes this long from
The lock has since moved on to a
leftover reserved feedback; pre-activation manifest match
Nothing re-runs any of these three sweeps later — a crash that happens
well after startup waits for the NEXT process restart to be recovered.
A queued/running run that is stale but not yet
deliberately left alone here, to avoid two runs
believing they own the same feedback.

svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. Absent mechanisms are named in a note, never drawn as implemented steps.
Every decision re-derives truth from the manifest and bundle files — never a bare MongoDB status field alone.
